entities.summary: Sergei Alexandrovich Monia is a Russian former professional basketball player. He was selected by the National Basketball Association (NBA) club the Portland Trail Blazers, in the first round of the 2004 NBA draft. At a height of 2.02 m tall, he played at both the small forward and power forward positions.
